title: Clean & Modern Title Screen
description: Removes the ugly Java Edition subtitle on the title screen and changes the panorama to be more generic.
body:
# About Clean & Modern Title Screen

Clean & Modern Title Screen primarily throws the Java Edition subtitle of the title screen out the window -- fully, with abosultely no naughty shadow smeared underneath the MINECRAFT logo.

The pack also replaces the update-themed panoramas with a random one from somewhere in a Minecraft world. Examples incude: Plains village, igloo, ocean monument, desert, The End's main island, basalt deltas, etc.


<details>
<summary>Pack name reason</summary>
  
**Clean**: no Java Edition text

**Modern**: The logo and panorama reflect Mojang's other panorama choices -- e.g. choosing a bamboo jungle for the Bedrock Beta panorama or a savanna village for the Bedrock Preview panorama.
</details>
